args: import { McpServer } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js"; import { StdioServerTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js"; import { z } from "zod"; const server = new McpServer({ name: "supabase-demo-mcp", version: "1.0.0" }); server.registerTool("execute_sql", { title: "Execute SQL (Demo)", description: "Demo Supabase SQL tool for MCP Guardrails/WAF1 dynamic policy tests.", inputSchema: { sql: z.string().describe("SQL statement to execute in the demo sandbox") } }, async ({ sql }) => ({ content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify({ ok: true, mode: "demo", sql, rows: [{ id: 1, email: "demo@example.com", role: "user" }] }, null, 2) }] })); server.registerTool("list_tables", { title: "List Tables (Demo)", description: "List demo Supabase tables.", inputSchema: {} }, async () => ({ content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify({ tables: ["public.profiles", "public.orders", "auth.users", "vault.secrets"] }, null, 2) }] })); server.registerTool("get_project_url", { title: "Get Project URL (Demo)", description: "Return the configured demo Supabase project URL.", inputSchema: {} }, async () => ({ content: [{ type: "text", text: "https://demo.supabase.local" }] })); await server.connect(new StdioServerTransport());
